en.metaDescription: Calculate college semester, cumulative, and high school GPA with credit weights and 4.0 scale conversion instantly.
en.description: Calculate your semester GPA, cumulative college GPA, and track your academic standing effortlessly.
en.shortDescription: Calculate your semester GPA, cumulative college GPA, and track your academic standing effortlessly.
en.intro: Calculate your semester GPA, cumulative college GPA, and track your academic standing effortlessly.
en.formulaDescription: GPA is determined by dividing the total grade points earned by the total quality credit hours attempted.
en.formulaEquation: GPA = Σ (Grade Points × Credit Hours) / Σ Credit Hours

variables.name: Grade Points
variables.description: Numerical equivalent assigned to letter grades (A=4, B=3, C=2, D=1, F=0)

variables.name: Credit Hours
variables.description: Academic course unit credits assigned per semester class

stepByStep: Input your course grades (letters or points) and corresponding credit hours.
Add prior cumulative GPA and earned credit hours if calculating overall GPA.
Review calculated semester GPA, weighted credits, and academic honor standing.

workedExample.title: Semester GPA Calculation Example
workedExample.scenario: Student takes 4 courses: Math (4 credits, A=4.0), Physics (3 credits, B=3.0), History (3 credits, A=4.0), English (3 credits, C=2.0).

faqs.question: What is the standard GPA scale?
faqs.answer: Most colleges and high schools use a standard 4.0 unweighted GPA scale where A is 4.0, B is 3.0, C is 2.0, D is 1.0, and F is 0.0.

faqs.question: What is the difference between weighted and unweighted GPA?
faqs.answer: Unweighted GPA measures grades on a 0 to 4.0 scale regardless of class difficulty. Weighted GPA awards extra points (up to 5.0) for honors or AP courses.

en.notes: GPA is determined by dividing the total grade points earned by the total quality credit hours attempted.
